lines.text: Paul proposes revisiting the brothers in every town where they proclaimed the word, but refuses to take Mark, who deserted them.
After a sharp disagreement, Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Crete, while Paul chose Silas and strengthened churches.
The Spirit of Jesus would not let them enter Galatia, so they passed Mysia and went to Troas.
Paul saw a night vision of a Macedonian man pleading for help, and they concluded God had called them.
